question: Which countries saw the biggest CO2 drop after 2008-09 and recovered fastest?
summary: Among large emitters, the steepest falls were Romania (-17.9%), Uzbekistan (-14.9%), Ukraine (-14.8%). The fastest to regain their 2008 emissions were Russia (2011), Uzbekistan (2024). Countries with the deepest drops did not always recover fastest; recovery depended on whether the fall was cyclical (demand) or structural (fuel switching, deindustrialisation).
